missionText.briefing:
Your mission is to free all of your
friends. Blow up all locks to free
them and to open the exit.
missionText.success:
Good work, but while you were freeing
your friends, the enemy has constructed
a secret weapon.
missionText.failure:
Use the reflecting walls and fueldumps
to destroy the enemy.
